Plastic without oil, from the Fermenter's Ethanol, all in the Chemical Reactor.
# Ethylene
- 100 mB Ethanol + 5 mB Sulfuric Acid (the catalyst) make 40 mB Ethylene (a gas) and 60 mB Water in 5 seconds. It works, but slowly: the Steam Cracker makes Ethylene by the bucket.
- The Water goes into the reactor's by-product tank and leaves by By-product faces.
# Plastic Sheet
- 120 mB Ethylene make 2 Plastic Sheets (bio-polyethylene). The Light Oil + Hydrogen recipe still works.

# PVC Sheet
- 60 mB Ethylene + 60 mB Chlorine make 2 PVC Sheets.
- Hardened and Arcforged Fluid Conduits and the Arcforged Fluid Tank take one, an acid-proof lining.
# #arcforge:plastics
Plastic, PVC and Polypropylene Sheet are all plastics: up to the Hardened tier, a recipe that takes plastic takes any of them.
# Polypropylene Sheet
- 120 mB Propylene (from the Steam Cracker) makes 2 Polypropylene Sheets in the Chemical Reactor.
- A plastic: any recipe that takes plastic (arcforge:plastics) takes it.

# Plastics by tier
Arcforged gear wants a particular sheet:
- PVC Sheet: the Arcforged Fluid Conduit and Fluid Tank (and the Hardened Fluid Conduit).
- Polypropylene Sheet: the Arcforged crate, vault and Storage Upgrade, and the Arcforged Jetpack.
- Plastic Sheet: the Arcforged Arc Drill and Arc Saw (and the Link Conduit and Battery Array Casing).
Propylene only comes from the Steam Cracker, so the top tier needs a refinery.
# Synthetic Rubber
- 60 mB Ethylene + 40 mB Propylene, over a Cracking Catalyst (used up about once in 50), make 1 Synthetic Rubber (EPDM) in 5 seconds.
- It cures in the Vulcanizer as Raw Rubber does.
